preconditions.description: The number of servers n must be between 1 and 30,000.
There must be exactly 4n replication rules provided.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= n for a, b, c in rules)
preconditions.description: Each rule must reference valid server numbers between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: If a valid order exists, output 'YES' followed by a permutation of rule indices; otherwise, output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(rule) <= 4 * n for rule in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: The output rule indices must be valid and within the range of 1 to 4n.
The output must contain each rule index exactly once.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= server_count <= 9 for server_count in server_counts)
invariants.description: At any point, the number of processes on each server must not exceed 9.
The total number of processes across all servers must equal the initial processes plus twice the number of applied rules.
